member.name: M:FWIntegrationAPI.Controllers.NLSController.GetVesselCalls(System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String,System.Nullable{System.Boolean},System.String,System.Nullable{System.Boolean})
member.summary: Get vessel calls information from external API
member.param: The IMO number of the vessel e.g. 9515802,9410026,8210699,5355632
Current name of the vessel. Additional functionality available, see 'Standard Functionality'. e.g. Queen Mary 2
MMSI number currently used by the vessel. e.g. 310627000
If supplied as ‘true’, known class B vessels will be included in the API response.
If no dateRange supplied the API will return the previous 7 days history. Maximum dateRange allowed is 6 months. e.g. 2020-12-01 – 2020-12-31
If supplied as ‘true’ will include details of berth callings within the port (requires additional subscription).
member.returns: Vessel call details in JSON format

member.name: M:FWIntegrationAPI.Controllers.NLSController.GetAdvancedComplianceRisk(System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Advanced Compliance risk ratings for one or more vessels, including risks flagged and their details across AIS Gaps, Loitering, AIS Manipulation, Flag, Ownership, Ship to Ship Transfer and movements (available by supplying either VesselId, VesselImo, VesselName, vesselMmsi)
member.param: The IMO number of the vessel e.g. 9515802,9410026,8210699,5355632
Current name of the vessel. Additional functionality available, see 'Standard Functionality'. e.g. Queen Mary 2
MMSI number currently used by the vessel. e.g. 310627000
Type of individual compliance risk that API endpoint output should fetch. For allowed values see below. Default All. e.g. flag,sts
Filter results by overall vessel compliance risk score. For allowed values see below. e.g. High,Medium
Filter results by AIS gap risk rating. For allowed values see below. e.g. High
member.returns: Vessel call details in JSON format
